summary: Ananya Mehra and Rohan Kapoor show a compatibility score of 81.8/100. The connection is shaped by 6 supportive synastry contacts and 6 high-friction contacts.

themes.title: Emotional Rhythm
themes.insight: Ananya Mehra's Moon in Aquarius meets Rohan Kapoor's Moon in Libra. Both charts lean into air and air emotional styles, which shapes how safety and closeness are built.

themes.title: Attraction Pattern
themes.insight: Ananya Mehra's Venus in Aries and Rohan Kapoor's Mars in Scorpio show the chemistry between affection and desire. Harmonious contact increases natural pull; harder contact creates heat that needs maturity.

themes.title: Communication Style
themes.insight: Mercury links between Ananya Mehra and Rohan Kapoor indicate how quickly misunderstandings get resolved. With Mercury in Taurus and Capricorn, clarity depends on whether both people process feelings through the same element.

themes.title: Long-Term Potential
themes.insight: The synastry leans more supportive than difficult, which usually means this connection has enough ease to grow. Shared rituals, emotional honesty, and clear commitments can turn attraction into durability.

facets.label: Bhakoot and Nadi
facets.sourcing: Moon sign distance counted both ways, and the Moon's nakshatra nadi in both charts

findings.text: The Moons are five and nine signs apart — nava-pancham, the most favourable Bhakoot there is. The tradition reads it as the pairing where each person's instinct makes sense to the other without explanation.
findings.basis: Ananya Mehra's Moon in Aquarius, Rohan Kapoor's in Libra — 5/9 Bhakoot

findings.text: The two Moons fall in different nadis, which is what matching asks for.
findings.basis: Ananya Mehra: Shatabhisha (Aadi), Rohan Kapoor: Vishakha (Antya)

facets.label: Chemistry across the charts
facets.sourcing: Venus against the other's Mars both ways, and Venus/Mars overlay into the partner's 7th, 8th and 12th

findings.text: Rohan Kapoor's Venus and Ananya Mehra's Mars share a sign. This is the strongest of the cross-chart attraction contacts — what one finds beautiful is what the other is driven toward, with no translation needed.

findings.text: Rohan Kapoor's Venus lands in Ananya Mehra's 7th — the house of the partner itself. Ananya Mehra is likely to experience Rohan Kapoor as partner-shaped from very early on.
findings.basis: Rohan Kapoor's Venus in Pisces, which is Ananya Mehra's 7th house

facets.label: The in-law reading, cross-checked
facets.sourcing: Each chart's bhavat-bhavam derivation from the 7th against the partner's own 4th and 9th — two independent routes to the same person

facets.label: Rest and privacy, by overlay
facets.sourcing: Each chart's planets falling in the other's 12th bhava

kalatra_synastry.method: Read between the two charts rather than within either. Mangal dosha is computed in both and then matched (dosha samya). Bhakoot counts the Moon-sign distance both ways; Nadi comes off the Moon's nakshatra. Overlay places one chart's planets in the other's whole-sign houses. Ashtakoota as a whole is not computed here — the page's own compatibility score already answers that question, and two totals would not reconcile.
